purpose: Diagnose and eliminate qualification-vs-controlled-execution graph divergence before any successor historical measurement.

accounting_rule.economic_fit_count: DATA_DEPENDENT_FROM_FROZEN_VALIDATION_ELIGIBILITY_RULES; must equal consumed eligible economic manifest fit units, not a synthetic full-support constant
accounting_rule.p08_nnls_count: DATA_DEPENDENT_FROM_FROZEN_BASE-PREDICTION-ELIGIBILITY_RULES; must equal consumed eligible P08 manifest units, not a synthetic full-support constant
accounting_rule.total_fit_count: validation_structural_count + realized eligible economic manifest fit units

qualification_pass_gates: Same graph-builder entry point used by qualification and controlled execution.
For each synthetic regime, independently generated qualification and controlled-mode dry-run manifests are byte-identical after canonical serialization.
For each regime, manifest SHA256 matches and execution trace terminates every manifest work unit exactly once.
Observed physical fits and NNLS solves equal eligible manifest actions for that regime.
Full-support regime reproduces 31,008 + 11,904 = 42,912 fits and 40 NNLS solves.
Partial/undefined regimes demonstrate lawful lower downstream counts without execution invalidation when every eligible manifest unit is consumed.
successor_historical_rule: 0068 itself never reads historical data. Only after 0068 is closed PASS may a new research ID copy the frozen 0067 scientific program and authorize a new exactly-once historical attempt under the 0068 execution-assurance contract.
